question: Can Midscene remain useful in the Bun and Playwright lab without its vulnerable unused package graph?

candidate.scope: Playwright observation and structured visible-UX review only
unsupported: any future route that imports either fail-closed stub

gateHardening.status: implemented; acceptance requires a complete exact-candidate rerun
corrections: closure independently parses exact command-bound artifacts
failure records require complete exact before/after manifests
repeated runs require distinct execution identities rather than labels
canonical stack command performs a fresh current-graph audit
execution UUID is bound into the record and first log line
Bun, Playwright, Bugsink and scan schemas are cross-field validated
each injected failure records its exact mode and confirms the injection was reached
audit acceptance requires an exact plain empty JSON object
Playwright validation recursively checks exact expected specs, tests and individual results
Bun validation requires one authoritative complete-suite summary with matching positive pass and executed-test counts
scan files require count and inventory consistency plus coverage of the run result
Bugsink log, stored result, cleanup identity and scan state must agree
passing Playwright results reject singular errors and nonempty stderr while permitting legitimate Midscene report notices on stdout
scan byte counts must cover the run-result artifact and cannot use negative member or decoded counts
gateHardening.priorEvidenceDisposition: stale after gate corrections; complete exact-candidate rerun required
